svg.title: After hours: Dota 2, Assassin’s Creed and a shelf of favorites
svg.desc: Arcade game-select screen. Two large featured cartridges: Dota 2 (selected, pixel three-lane map) and Assassin’s Creed (pixel rooftops and a bird). Below, six smaller slots: Attack on Titan and Dragon Ball Z (anime), The Office and Breaking Bad (series), Interstellar (film), Avicii (music).
